newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish govt/unions agree to dole limit proposal.
newsitem.headline: Swedish govt/unions agree to dole limit proposal.

text.p: Sweden's minority Social Democrat government and umbrella union organisation LO have agreed to a proposed three-year time limit on unemployment benefits, Sweden's Labour Minister said on Wednesday.
"We have agreed on a time limit on unemployment benefits," Labour Minister Margareta Winberg told a news conference.
A decision on the proposed three-year limit could be made and take effect on July 1, 1999.
But Winberg said the limit must be looked at more closely before a final decision is made and pointed to measures that could be implemented before and afterwards.
These included opportunities for people who will lose benefits to work in a government work centre, state subsidised salaries and retirement.
Additionally, the cost burden between the state and municipalities should be investigated further, Winberg said.
